title_note: The English title is a working translation, not an enacted title. The Hebrew title is the form printed in the enabling words of the 2007 amending regulations (Kovetz HaTakanot 6586, printed page 830) and in section 1 of the 2015 temporary-provision law (Sefer HaChukim 2495, printed page 197); the Law's own 1992 print is not among the pages deposited, so the form of the title in that print is not stated here.
